lineageSchema.parentSourceId: assetId of the immediate parent in generation history; null for Source-of-Truth originals
lineageSchema.siblings: assets that share the same parentSourceId (same generation batch / alternate takes)
lineageSchema.walkToSot: follow parentSourceId until null to reach the master original
